GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out & Settled Down last 10 Lengths from the lead, railed up to 7.5 Lengths still last turning, hugged fence and Made Ground along rail in Straight # never left fence
Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths turning, dropped off in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # missed the start
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , Moved Up to Two Wide joint Lead turning, Headed rounding turn and Dropped Out in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early stages.] # weakened badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Near the 300m whilst weakening, had to ease when racing close to the heels of TRUST IN THE ROCK.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly & bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed same until pushed to chase 3 Wide @ 550m. Chasing Four Wide @ 400m & pressured 3 Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground in straight. # Never a chance.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped. Steadied leaving the winning post on the first occasion when tightened for room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 4th 3 Wide trailing 3 Lengths , in Two Wide soon after, held together much same to turn 4 Lengths Two Wide and 3rd, held position as winner got firther away in Straight # no threat 3rd

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed fit to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: sat behind the speed made no ground 2len Hard Ridden 600m/weakened poor run # vweak late

Debut for stable. Vetted pre-race. Began evenly. Not pushed early & raced keenly Worse than midfield 3 Wide With Cover (4L from lead). Stayed same until Four Wide @ 550m. Held up Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & laid in while giving ground in last 200m. # Wide & weakened.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination and was passed fit to start. Had to be checked and taken out near the 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well . Immediately Went Forward Crossed Two Wide 2nd, within 1 length @ 1200m. back to 3rd on home Turn Ridden Along . 4th Straightening Up all Clear but spent force now. dropped right out # weak once beat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported had been given no firm instructions and when caught wide in the early stages he elected to allow his mount to stride forward and settle outside the leader.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 2 Lengths settled winners back Off Mid-Field 2wide 8l improved to 6l Straightening Up kept on one pace # even effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Rider Dean Yendall could offer no explanation for the performance and expressed disappointment with the manner the gelding finished the race. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.
